Hello,

For the PoE switches you install with Hikvision kits, two neutral-brand units from small lots: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); budget 8-PoE + 2 uplink unmanaged, in the slot of the DS-3E0518P-E - STC-028GP - $25.1. One question: which band do your installations use most - budget unmanaged or managed PoE?

Best regards,
Alan
